response.hypothesis: The evidence supports an order failure rather than new grasp or height errors: the mug predicate was initially true, but placing the pudding second produced place timeouts, pushed the pudding beyond y=0.15 in two runs, and in init 3 displaced the already placed mug to 0.0479 m from the plate origin. I changed only the execution order, placing the pudding first at the previously tested y=0.14 target and the mug second. This removes the mug as an obstacle during pudding placement and prevents the later pudding operation from knocking the mug off the plate; all grasp, height, tolerance, offset, and yaw values are otherwise unchanged.

objects.derivation: Execute the pudding first so the mug cannot obstruct or deflect its placement. The yaw-zero site at (0.15,0.10,0.41) plus offset (0,0.04,0) targets world xy=(0.15,0.14), inside the accepted x=(0.10,0.20), y=(0.05,0.15) box. At yaw 180 the pudding half-width along y is 0.0463/2=0.02315 m, so its lower edge is y=0.11685, leaving 0.04155 m from the initial plate AABB maximum y=0.0753. The table surface z=0.4368 plus origin-above-bottom 0.0131 gives resting origin z=0.4499, or 0.0399 above site z=0.4100; place_dz=0.0449 provides a 0.005 m settling drop and remains inside accepted z=(0.412,0.517). Lift 0.15 raises the bottom from z=0.4368 to 0.5868. Transport 0.18 carries the bottom at 0.4100+0.1800-0.0131=0.5769, above all initial object tops. Yaw 180 preserves the initial orientation and the rectangular footprint has 180-degree symmetry.

The demonstrated-geometry candidate secured and transported the mug in every latest run, so it is retained. Mug yaw -90 plus reference relative hand yaw 10.3 gives -79.7 degrees; rotating reference xy=(-0.0319,-0.0130) and projecting into the candidate axes gives lateral=-0.0337 and longitudinal=-0.0071 m, with reference dz=0.101 m. Plate top z=0.4557 and mug origin_above_bottom=-0.0024 give resting mug-origin z=0.4557-0.0024=0.4533, which is 0.0140 m above plate origin z=0.4393; place_dz=0.019 adds a 0.005 m settling drop. Tolerance 0.004 m is below the required 0.03 m origin radius. Lift 0.15 raises the initial mug bottom from z=0.4368 to 0.5868; transport 0.15 carries its bottom near z=0.4393+0.15+0.0024=0.5917. With the pudding already centered at y=0.14, its lower footprint edge is about y=0.11685, separated from the plate and mug placement around y=0.0057.
